title: OAuth2 Authentication (OAuthProvider + account re-auth)
description: Implement OAuthProvider as a drop-in IAuthProvider replacement using a terminal-only, API-based OAuth2 flow (no browser, no redirect listener). Activate account re-auth and support --client-id / --client-secret at account add.
prerequisiteState: All v1 stories complete. IAuthProvider, PatAuthProvider, AccountStore, and account commands all working. account re-auth returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED stub.
goal: A user can add an OAuth2 account with --client-id and --client-secret. account re-auth exchanges a new token via the Zoho OAuth2 API from the terminal without a browser. api call on an account with needs_reauth=false uses the OAuth token transparently.
scope: Create src/CliqCli.Core/Auth/OAuthProvider.cs implementing IAuthProvider; stores access token under key 'cliq-cli:<accountName>:oauth' and refresh token under 'cliq-cli:<accountName>:oauth_refresh' via IKeychainProvider
OAuthProvider.StoreTokenAsync: accepts a combined 'access_token|refresh_token' format (or accept two-field DTO); calls ZohoCorpGuard.AssertNotZohoCorp(email) before any keychain write
OAuthProvider.GetTokenAsync: reads access token; if access token is expired (check expiry field in AccountEntry -- add ExpiresAt? DateTimeOffset field), call RefreshTokenAsync internally
Implement token exchange: POST https://accounts.{domain}/oauth/v2/token with grant_type=client_credentials and client_id/client_secret; store response access_token + refresh_token
Implement token refresh: POST https://accounts.{domain}/oauth/v2/token with grant_type=refresh_token and refresh_token; update stored tokens
Update AccountEntry: add optional ClientId? string and ExpiresAt? DateTimeOffset fields for OAuth accounts
Update AccountStore: save/load new optional fields (backward-compatible — null if absent in existing accounts.json)
Update AddAccountSettings: add --client-id and --client-secret optional flags; if both present, use OAuthProvider flow instead of PatAuthProvider
Update Program.cs DI: register OAuthProvider alongside PatAuthProvider; use a factory/strategy pattern on IAuthProvider that selects implementation based on AccountEntry.TokenType ('pat' vs 'oauth')
Activate ReAuthAccountCommand: replace NOT_IMPLEMENTED stub with OAuthProvider.RefreshTokenAsync call, clear NeedsReauth

Unit tests: OAuthProvider stores tokens with correct keychain keys; OAuthProvider rejects zohocorp domain; token refresh is called when ExpiresAt < UtcNow; re-auth clears NeedsReauth; api call after re-auth proceeds without NEEDS_REAUTH
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
account add --name work --client-id cid --client-secret csec exchanges tokens via Zoho OAuth2 API and stores them in keychain with token_type='oauth'
OAuthProvider.GetTokenAsync returns the access token; if expired, refreshes transparently
account re-auth --name work exchanges a new token and sets needs_reauth=false, returns success
api call after account re-auth proceeds normally without NEEDS_REAUTH error
OAuthProvider.StoreTokenAsync with a zohocorp.com email → ACCOUNT_DOMAIN_BLOCKED, exit 1
ApiClient.CallAsync selects OAuthProvider for oauth accounts and PatAuthProvider for pat accounts via the auth strategy
Access and refresh tokens never appear in any output, accounts.json, or trace files
Existing PAT accounts in accounts.json continue to work without migration
No browser window, redirect URL, or local HTTP server required at any point
contextForAgent: Read ADR-0005 — specifically the planned v2 OAuth flow: API-based terminal flow, client credentials or device-authorization grant, calling Zoho OAuth2 endpoints directly. Read OQ-001 for user-info endpoint. The IAuthProvider DI registration needs to change from a singleton to a factory/keyed service that selects PatAuthProvider or OAuthProvider based on AccountEntry.TokenType. ApiClient must resolve the auth provider per-account. Consider using .NET keyed services (IKeyedServiceProvider) or a simple factory class AuthProviderFactory.Create(tokenType). Do NOT add a browser or local HTTP listener under any circumstances.

openItems.defaultAssumption: POST https://accounts.{domain}/oauth/v2/token. For client_credentials: body = { grant_type: client_credentials, client_id: ..., client_secret: ... }. Response: { access_token, refresh_token, expires_in (seconds) }. Store ExpiresAt = UtcNow + expires_in seconds.

Create internal sealed class AuthProviderSelector in CliqCli.Core with a GetProvider(string tokenType) method returning IAuthProvider. Register both PatAuthProvider and OAuthProvider in DI as named/keyed services. ApiClient receives AuthProviderSelector via constructor injection.
